_comment: Every entry is a triple: behavior, verification command, state. State machine: not_started -> active -> passing (irreversible) or active -> blocked. Granularity: each feature should be completable in one session.

features.name: HybridACD bound math matches Table 1 consistency rules
features.behavior: get_consistency_bounds() in hybrid_acd_forecaster.py returns [l,u] intervals matching the algebraic formulas in paper Table 1 (Negation, Paraphrase, And, Or, Cond at minimum) for known previous predictions.
features.evidence: test_bounds_neg_checker, test_bounds_paraphrase_checker, test_bounds_and_checker already exist and pass in repo as of current commit

features.name: HybridACDForecaster config dump/load round-trips
features.behavior: dump_config()/load_config() preserve model, adversarial_model, adversarial_enabled, tcd_enabled, research_enabled fields exactly.
features.evidence: test_hybrid_acd_config_dump_load exists and passes in repo

features.name: Full-pipeline smoke run produces a valid AVS on a live model
features.behavior: Running evaluation.py with HybridACDForecaster on 5 scraped-tuple questions against a real model API exits 0 and stats_summary.json contains a non-null AVS field.

features.name: Reproduce paper's AVS reduction on at least one model
features.behavior: Full 200-line evaluation on src/data/tuples/scraped with HybridACDForecaster (model=gpt-4o-mini) yields AVS within reasonable tolerance of the paper's reported 0.0007 (paper Table 2).
features.verification: see docs/verification.md 'Full evaluation' section, compare src/data/forecasts/HybridACD_gpt-4o-mini_run/stats_summary.json AVS to paper Table 2

features.name: Reproduce ablation study (TCD-only vs adversarial-only vs full)
features.behavior: Three evaluation runs (adversarial_enabled/tcd_enabled toggled per paper Table 5) on gpt-4o-mini reproduce the qualitative ordering: full < TCD-only < adversarial-only for AVS.
features.verification: see docs/verification.md 'Ablation' section, three runs + manual AVS comparison

features.name: Calibration Error regression investigation (Mistral models)
features.behavior: Paper flags increased Calibration Error on Mistral-Medium-3.5 and Mistral-Small-4 after HybridACD as unresolved ('†'). Investigate whether narrower [l,u] intervals correlate with the regression, propose a soft-penalty alternative to hard clipping.
features.verification: written analysis + notebook comparing interval width vs calibration delta per question, no fixed pass/fail command yet — define one before marking active

features.name: Retrieval-augmented small-model forecasting
features.behavior: Add a pre-elicitation retrieval step (news/context search) to HybridACDForecaster, run before adversarial rewrite + TCD, with a hard date-cutoff filter enforced per question (search results must predate the question's created_at / effective forecast date — never the resolution date) to prevent outcome leakage on already-resolved tuple sets (e.g. src/data/tuples/scraped). Hypothesis: a small model (e.g. gpt-4o-mini or smaller) with retrieval closes most of the Brier-score gap to a large model without retrieval, while TCD keeps AVS low regardless of model size or retrieval.
features.verification: Non-retrieval baselines already exist on disk (confirmed 2026-08-23) — no fresh runs needed for those: small = BasicForecaster_gpt4o_mini_2024-07-18_20240501_20240815 (Brier 0.202, CE 0.142) and its tuples_scraped AVS counterpart (0.0300 default / 0.1874 freq); large = BasicForecaster_gpt4o_2024-08-06_20240501_20240815 (Brier 0.179, CE 0.065) or CoT_ForecasterTextBeforeParsing_o1-preview_20240501_20240815 (Brier 0.168). PREREQUISITE before using it as a reference: audit ResolverBasedForecaster_llama-3.1-sonar-large-128k_20240501_20240815 (Brier 0.096, notably better than every non-retrieval baseline including large models) for whether its search calls enforce a pre-resolution date cutoff — if not, its number reflects possible outcome leakage (the scraped set resolved May-Aug 2024, evaluated well after), not a clean retrieval result, and cannot be used as an upper-bound reference until re-run with a cutoff. Only after that audit: run the treatment (HybridACDForecaster + retrieval, small model) and report all four numbers in one table (small/no-retrieval, large/no-retrieval, resolver/retrieval-audited, treatment) per docs/conventions.md baseline-first rule.
features.blocked_by: F003 (smoke run harness must be proven working before adding a retrieval step to it); also blocked on the ResolverBasedForecaster date-cutoff audit above
